# Flipping is Hard Wiki

> Fan wiki for Flipping is Hard, the Foddian-style rage platformer by Elegant Horse Studios — how to flip and climb, area guides for all 10 surreal zones, online co-op and the Getting Over It comparison.

Site: https://flippingishardgame.wiki

- Flipping is Hard Guide — the complete orientation: https://flippingishardgame.wiki/guide/flipping-is-hard-guide

- Co-op Guide — the climb as a crowd: https://flippingishardgame.wiki/guide/co-op-guide
- Tips & Mindset — the rage, managed: https://flippingishardgame.wiki/guide/tips-and-mindset
